triples.tail_surface: alarm point where the liquid reaches a predetermined level in the overflow tank to give the high level warning
triples.evidence_text: The drop lines from the common headers to the overflow tank are to terminate above the maximum liquid level in the overflow tank (i.e., above the alarm point where the liquid reaches a predetermined level in the overflow tank to give the high level warning).

triples.tail_surface: liquid reaches a predetermined level in the overflow tank
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 溢流舱液位达到预定值
triples.evidence_text: above the alarm point where the liquid reaches a predetermined level in the overflow tank to give the high level warning

triples.head_surface: venting arrangement of the overflow tank
triples.tail_surface: permit the free passage of air from the individual tanks, the vent/overflow headers and the overflow tank vent to atmosphere under all conditions
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 保证各舱及透气管路在所有工况下自由通气
triples.evidence_text: The venting arrangement of the overflow tank is to permit the free passage of air from the individual tanks, the vent/overflow headers and the overflow tank vent to atmosphere under all conditions.

triples.tail_surface: not to be filled by using a cascade filling arrangement
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 禁止采用梯级溢流加注方式
triples.evidence_text: The storage tanks are not to be filled by using a cascade filling arrangement (i.e., tanks are not to be filled by overflowing from one to another).

triples.tail_surface: manned at all times during bunkering and/or fuel oil transfer operations
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 加装燃油或燃油驳运期间始终有人值守
triples.evidence_text: The fueling station(s) is/are to be manned at all times during bunkering and/or fuel oil transfer operations.

triples.head_surface: overflow pipes exposed to the weather
triples.tail_surface: wall thicknesses not less than standard thickness
triples.evidence_text: overflow pipes exposed to the weather are to have wall thicknesses not less than standard thickness

triples.head_surface: Overflow pipes not exposed to the weather
triples.evidence_text: Overflow pipes not exposed to the weather are to meet the thickness requirements of vents in 4-6-4/9.3.2(b).

triples.head_surface: tanks, cofferdams, void spaces and all normally dry compartments... which have the possibility of water accumulation
triples.head_canonical_zh: 可能积水的舱室及干燥处所
triples.tail_surface: means of sounding the level of liquid present
triples.evidence_text: All tanks, cofferdams, void spaces and all normally dry compartments, such as cargo holds, which are not easily accessible, and which have the possibility of water accumulation (e.g. adjacent to sea, pipe passing through), are to be provided with a means of sounding the level of liquid present.

triples.tail_surface: quick closure valve is to be fitted to indicate flooding
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装速闭阀以指示进水
triples.evidence_text: Where access is provided, a quick closure valve is to be fitted to indicate flooding.
